description: This file defines the 'Language' entity class for a Human Resource Management system. It models a language with properties such as 'id' and 'name', and maintains a collection of associated EmployeeLanguage entities, representing the relationship between languages and employees.

classes.name: Language
classes.description: Entity class representing a language in the HRM system, with properties for ID, name, and related employee languages.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the language.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the ID of the language.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the language.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the name of the language.
